proposed_widenings.name: area_shape_contiguous_cubes
proposed_widenings.justification: Fire Storm's area of effect is 'up to ten 10-foot Cubes' arranged contiguously by the caster at cast time. The current Attachment.area.shape union only contains { kind: 'sphere'; radiusFeet: number }. A cube-based shape variant — minimally { kind: 'contiguous_cubes'; cubeSideFeet: number; maxCubes: number } — is needed to represent this spell without lying about its geometry.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot Cubes, which you arrange as you like. Each Cube must be contiguous with at least one other Cube.

notes: The primary mechanic encodes cleanly into the existing activation/save_gate path: DEX save against caster spell save DC, 7d10 Fire damage on fail, half on success. The only blocker is Attachment.area.shape lacking a cube variant. The secondary effect (flammable unattended objects start burning) is an environmental world-state effect on objects with no creature-targeting resolution; it would be deferred or classified dm_agenda if surveyed separately, and does not affect this classification.
